#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class FFT {
public:
    class Vector {
    public:
        int length = 1 << 20;
        std::vector<long long> data;

        Vector(const std::vector<long long>& array) {
            data.resize(length, 0);
            std::copy(array.begin(), array.end(), data.begin());
        }

        std::vector<long long> performFFT() {
            return computeDFT(0, 1, true);
        }

        std::vector<long long> performInverseFFT() {
            std::vector<long long> result = computeDFT(0, 1, false);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < result.size(); ++i) {
                result[i] = result[i] * invSize % mod;
            }
            return result;
        }

        std::vector<long long> computeDFT(int startIdx, int stepSize, bool forward) {
            if (stepSize == length) {
                return std::vector<long long>{data[startIdx]};
            }
            auto leftPart = computeDFT(startIdx, stepSize * 2, forward);
            auto rightPart = computeDFT(startIdx + stepSize, stepSize * 2, forward);
            int n = leftPart.size();
            std::vector<long long> combined(2 * n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                long long factor = (forward ? warr[i * stepSize] : winvarr[i * stepSize]) * rightPart[i] % mod;
                combined[i] = (leftPart[i] + factor) % mod;
                combined[n + i] = (leftPart[i] - factor + mod) % mod;
            }
            return combined;
        }
    };

    long long mod = 998244353;
    long long w = 646;
    long long wInverse;
    std::vector<long long> warr(1 << 20);
    std::vector<long long> winvarr(1 << 20);
    long long invSize;

    FFT() {
        wInverse = modInverse(w, mod);
        invSize = modInverse(1 << 20, mod);
        for (int i = 1; i < (1 << 20); ++i) {
            warr[i] = warr[i - 1] * w % mod;
            winvarr[i] = winvarr[i - 1] * w % mod;
        }
    }

    void execute() {
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        std::vector<long long> array(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int idx;
            cin >> idx;
            array[idx] = 1;
        }
        std::vector<long long> transformed = transformFFT(array);
        transformed = raiseToPower(transformed, n / 2);
        Vector vector(transformed);
        transformed = vector.performInverseFFT();
        long long total = 0;
        for (auto val : transformed) {
            total = (total + val * val) % mod;
        }
        cout << total << "\n";
    }

    long long powMod(long long base, int exp) {
        long long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    long long modInverse(long long a, long long m) {
        // Using Fermat's little theorem since m is prime
        return powMod(a, m - 2);
    }

    std::vector<long long> transformFFT(const std::vector<long long>& array) {
        std::vector<long long> result(1 << 20, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < result.size(); ++i) {
            long long val = 1;
            for (size_t j = 0; j < array.size(); ++j) {
                result[i] = (result[i] + array[j] * val) % mod;
                val = (val * w) % mod;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    std::vector<long long> raiseToPower(std::vector<long long>& array, int power) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < array.size(); ++i) {
            array[i] = powMod(array[i], power);
        }
        return array;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    FFT fft;
    fft.execute();
    return 0;
}
